engineering_assumptions.statement: Package measurements use the declared grid and units; no visual-only proxy counts as measured accuracy.

assumptions.statement: One small package opens in the real loader, contains the required fields, and stays below the stated memory limit.
assumptions.success_condition: The loader opens the sample; one decoded value matches the hand calculation; elapsed time and peak memory are recorded.

budget_bounds.bound: At most 1 GiB for the small test package.

deliverable.description: Versioned package specification defining data encoding, units, filenames, required fields and compatibility, with sample package and validation command.

approach.completion_condition: The sample package passes the specification validation command; the specification includes every field required by the consumer loader.
